name: Noha Nabil
note: Live Saudi Shopify storefront (Shopify country=SA, SAR primary), but Gate 1 in-country HQ is not substantiated: founder is Kuwaiti, the brand runs parallel AED/SAR Gulf storefronts and stores (Dubai/Riyadh/Jeddah), and no Saudi corporate registration/HQ is evidenced. Store-country config only reflects the Saudi market storefront, not the operating entity's global HQ (ambiguous between in-scope Kuwait and out-of-scope UAE).

name: nukhbatech
note: Real Riyadh tech store, but Gate 2 hybrid-B2B is unresolved: catalog leans on business-oriented lines (access-control, attendance devices, gate/barrier systems) alongside consumer items, and the site now returns 403 with search budget exhausted, so pure-B2C status and the inferred (never actually counted) 50-SKU scale can't be confirmed either way.

name: O100
note: Independently verified: genuine Riyadh niche-perfume/beauty retailer (est. 2014) with physical showrooms and a live online store; approved consumable category, Saudi HQ. The original keyword-only reason holds up.

name: oceanpharmacy
note: Verified live (HTTP 200) with heavy pharmacy/skin/baby/care breadth, SAR pricing and a payment/checkout flow, and 300+ السعودية references. Pharmacy is explicitly approved; Saudi geography confirmed.

name: Oud Elite
note: About page confirms establishment in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia (2007) with 340+ Gulf branches and live perfume/oud e-commerce (approved consumable, repeat). Independent check confirms it is NOT related to Arabian Oud, so no duplicate concern.

name: Panda Retail Company - Savola Group
note: One of Saudi Arabia's largest hypermarket chains (Savola Group); grocery approved with overwhelming scale. The site's Vercel bot-detection is anti-scraping, not a dead-business signal.

name: Pharmaciaty
note: Substantial Saudi online pharmacy (Tamer Group, Jeddah), 12,000+ products. Pharmacy explicitly approved; strong scale and clear Saudi geography.

name: Platinum Appliances
note: Verified live Saudi e-commerce store (Shop Now/cart, kingdom-wide delivery), broad home-appliance range, retailer not manufacturer, no B2B language. Approved appliances category; the weak keyword-only reason holds up.

name: Point Plus
note: Verified live Salla store (Saudi platform, SAR, checkout); games/toys retailer with Riyadh/Dammam delivery. Toys approved and multi-item, Saudi geography confirmed.

name: POWR
note: Gate 2 category failure: powr.sa is a Saudi esports/content-creation organization whose 'store' is single-brand fan merchandise (team T-shirts/hoodies/perfume), not a retail/eCommerce business. The ICP rulebook itself cites POWR as a prior NAICS misclassification; keeping it on a deferred 'not re-litigated' basis was not warranted.

name: Qaf Coffee Roasters
note: Verified live Salla store (Saudi, SAR, checkout); specialty coffee roaster/retailer. F&B/coffee is an approved, high-repeat consumable category.

name: Rasees Perfumes
note: Verified live Salla store (Saudi platform, SAR, checkout); broad perfume e-commerce. Approved consumable/repeat category, Saudi operations.

name: rasseed
note: Qualifies via the Gate 5b app-download rescue path; the ICP rulebook explicitly lists Rasseed as a confirmed 50k+/100k+ download case that qualifies outright.

name: Rawan Stationery
note: Verified live Salla store (Saudi, SAR, checkout); stationery/gifts (approved books/stationery), Jeddah/Riyadh delivery, consumable/repeat category.

name: Razan Alazzouni
note: Well-known Riyadh-based Saudi luxury designer; live Shopify store with a broad multi-category catalog (dresses/tops/skirts/jackets/accessories/shoes). Fashion/luxury approved, seasonal and multi-item.

name: rebound
note: Gate 4 not confirmed: rebound.net currently returns Shopify HTTP 402 'Store unavailable' (a closed/frozen store), contradicting the prior 'live activewear retailer' claim, and it has a documented history of dead-Shopify findings. The rulebook's mandated dead-site domain-move search could not be run (search budget exhausted), so a live channel can't be confirmed either way.

name: reefperfumes
note: Verified live Salla store (Saudi, SAR, free shipping over 222 SAR, 3-hour delivery); broad perfume + beauty range. Approved consumable category, Saudi operations.

name: Richy Group
note: Riyadh-HQ'd homegrown Saudi retail brand (founded 1952), consumer textiles/fabrics and apparel. Fabric/textile retail for garment-making is explicitly approved under Gate 3; geography and scale confirmed.

name: RIS Group
note: Gate 2 hybrid-B2B failure: Jeddah-HQ'd 'furnishing solution group' mixes consumer furniture retail (RIS Living) with B2B office/hospitality project furnishing (for corporates, banks, schools) and an interior-design consultancy (RIS Interiors), with a dedicated B2B Projects page on the same site. The B2B/fit-out side disqualifies at the group level even with a genuine B2C arm.

name: roastinghouse
note: Verified live and substantial: Riyadh-HQ'd coffee retailer (CR 1010363756), hundreds of SKUs across beans/equipment/accessories, SAR pricing, working checkout, branches in Jeddah/Khamis. Resolves the original 'thin visible text' hedge; F&B approved.

name: rootsfurniture
note: Al Rugaib-backed furniture/home-decor retailer, Al Khobar/Dhahran HQ; broad multi-category catalog with live cart and 50+ SKUs. Furniture/home approved, Saudi HQ established.

name: rubaiyat
note: Confirmed live Saudi luxury fashion e-commerce (cart/checkout, free-shipping threshold), broad catalog (clothing/shoes/bags/jewelry), self-identified Saudi destination with Jeddah/Riyadh same-day delivery. Fashion approved.

name: Saadeddinpastry
note: Major 145-branch Saudi bakery/sweets chain (F&B approved, high-repeat). Owned checkout is evidenced by an Apple Pay JS SDK plus GA/GTM and corroborated by live aggregator ordering; the owned cart is inferred (JS SPA) but the business and its online transacting are clearly real and Saudi.

name: saco
note: Major Saudi consumer home-improvement/general-merchandise retailer (since 1985, 32 branches, 50,000+ products, live cart, iOS/Android apps). Consumer DIY/home retail (not a construction-materials or B2B contracting supplier); overwhelming scale.

name: Saudi Jawahir
note: Real Riyadh luxury retailer, but Gate 4 live channel is not confirmed: jawahir.sa returns a persistent Cloudflare error 1000 'DNS points to prohibited IP' (refuting the prior pass's 'transient DNS error' assumption), a live cart/checkout was never actually confirmed (the prior resolution only established the business exists), and the dead-site domain-move search couldn't be run (search budget exhausted).

name: SAUDI KITCHEN LINE
note: Verified live ('Kitchen Line International') with add-to-cart and showroom presence across Jeddah/Riyadh/Makkah/Khamis Mushait. Home/kitchenware (general merchandise) approved; Saudi geography confirmed by the four-city footprint.

name: saudi-house
note: Gate 4 failure: the own site is a brochure/catalog with no native cart or checkout and redirects purchases to Noon.com and beitcom.com (third-party marketplaces). Despite being a genuine 1975 Riyadh department store, it has no owned transactional channel or app.

name: saudiradwa
note: Gate 2 failure: Radwa is a poultry PRODUCER/factory (listed under 'Made in Saudi factories') whose model explicitly serves 'both retail consumers and food service customers' (hybrid B2B/food-service). Manufacturing plus the B2B side disqualify regardless of the D2C grocery arm.

name: SAVECO Online Hypermarket
note: The qualifying premise is factually false: SAVECO is a Kuwait-based hypermarket (Al-Qatami Group, est. 2013), NOT 'Savola Group's online hypermarket arm' (a Saveco/Savola conflation; Panda is Savola's actual chain). No domain on file and no confirmed live e-commerce, so Gate 7 defaults OUT.

name: Scent
note: Arabian Oud: Riyadh-HQ'd (1982) luxury perfume/oud house with 1,200+ stores and live e-commerce. Consumer perfume retail (approved consumable/repeat); scale exceptionally well established.

name: Scrub N
note: Independently verified as a substantial apparel retailer (not a healthcare provider): medical scrubs/lab coats/uniforms, ~10,600 SKUs across 24 brands, 10 Saudi/Bahrain stores plus a live online store, Riyadh-based. Apparel approved, B2C to individual professionals; the weak keyword-only reason actually holds up strongly on scale.

name: Season | سيزون
note: Major Saudi fashion/accessories/perfume chain (~150 branches) with live e-commerce and real category pages. Fashion approved; Saudi geography and scale established.
